neighbours.label: the end of a factual clause in news/explanatory prose (sentence-final period, 'has been shown')
fire: The bridge was closed for repairs in 2019. Traffic has been slow ever since.
Researchers still disagree about the cause. Some blame the weather.
The team unveiled a new logo on Friday. Fans were not impressed.
These diets have long been shown to lower blood pressure.
The museum reopened after a long renovation. Visitors lined up for hours.
The singer released a surprise album at midnight. It sold out quickly.
The vaccine has been shown to reduce severe illness.
Engineers found a crack in the main beam. Repairs will take months.
quiet: The bridge was closed for repairs in 2019 and traffic has been slow ever since
Researchers still disagree about the cause and some blame the weather
The team unveiled a new logo on Friday but fans were not impressed
These diets are popular with people who want lower blood pressure
The museum reopened after a long renovation and visitors lined up for hours
The singer released a surprise album at midnight and it sold out quickly
The vaccine is given to people at risk of severe illness
Engineers found a crack in the main beam and repairs will take months

notes: The + pole is a strong 'think of X as' unit (promotes think/imagine); the - pole fires on sentence-final '.' and on 'shown'. Near misses drop the inner period.
